title: Global Debt Report 2026: Sustaining Debt Market Resilience Under Growing Pressure
summary: The OECD Global Debt Report 2026 is the third edition of an annual publication analyzing global sovereign and corporate bond market trends from 2007 to 2026. Chapter 1 examines sovereign borrowing requirements, funding strategies, debt-to-GDP dynamics, borrowing costs, yield curve shapes, refinancing risks, and market liquidity for OECD countries. Chapter 2 covers corporate debt markets (bonds, syndicated loans, private credit) focusing on credit spread drivers, AI expansion impact, and whether corporate debt has become more equity-like. Chapter 3 analyzes the investor base evolution for government and corporate bonds.
key_points: Chapter 1 (Sovereign Borrowing Outlook) covers sovereign bond market developments from 2007-2026 for OECD countries with focus on borrowing requirements, funding strategies, debt-to-GDP ratios, yield curves, refinancing risks, and market liquidity
Chapter 2 analyzes global corporate debt markets including bonds, syndicated loans, and private credit for financial and non-financial companies
Chapter 2 focuses on drivers of corporate credit spread movements and impact of AI expansion on corporate debt markets
Chapter 3 examines changes in sovereign and corporate bond holdings at aggregate and regional levels from 2007-2026
Report draws on multiple OECD surveys: 2025 Survey on Primary Market Developments, 2025 Survey on Liquidity in Government Bond Secondary Markets, and 2025 Questionnaire on Pension Fund Holdings
Report covers only sovereign and corporate bond markets; does not cover supranational or sub-sovereign bond markets
why_it_matters: This annual report provides authoritative, comprehensive data on global debt market structure, investor base composition, and market liquidity conditions. Market participants need this information to understand sovereign and corporate debt market resilience, refinancing risks, and potential vulnerabilities under stress conditions. The investor base analysis is particularly relevant for understanding who holds sovereign debt and how ownership composition affects market dynamics.
macro_context: The report addresses key macro-financial linkages including sovereign debt-to-GDP dynamics across OECD countries, refinancing risks at elevated debt levels, corporate credit spread drivers, and implications of AI expansion on corporate debt markets. It provides the analytical foundation for assessing global debt market sustainability.
market_structure_context: Chapter 1 includes analysis of market liquidity in government bond secondary markets; Chapter 3 provides detailed investor base analysis for both sovereign and corporate bonds including changes in holdings at aggregate and regional levels from 2007-2026; report draws on dedicated liquidity surveys
